__comment: EXAMPLE/DEV rules (vanilla-only, so they work in the standalone run). A 'to' rule is an automatic swap applied at placement to the exact block/tag it names (oak_planks->spruce_planks). A 'to_tag' rule is an INTERACTIVE candidate pool: the GUI 'Replace' picker shows a row per matching source block and lets the player pick a replacement from that tag. Either target may add an optional 'apply_properties' object (blockstate property name -> value) stamped onto the result after the swap - e.g. {"no_gravity":"true"} so a substituted TFC cobble is placed non-falling; a property the target block doesn't define is skipped. NOTE: a published library normally ships NO active rules (these would rewrite everyone's blueprints); delete this file for a clean library and let consumers supply rules under data/<their_namespace>/block_substitutions/. (Removed the cobblestone->mossy example because it shadowed :compat's cobblestone->#mctfc:mortared_cobblestone rule in the full-stack run.)

replacements.__note: apply_properties example: the picked log is stamped axis=x, so it places lying on its side. Same mechanism a TFC pack would use for {"no_gravity":"true"} on a cobble.
